title: Make Your Own Signature Scent in Tampa
blurb: Step into the Tijon Fragrance Lab in Tampa’s vibrant Ybor City, where history, creativity, and culture meet. In this hands-on perfume-making class, you’ll blend rare oils and botanicals to design your very own signature fragrance, bottled to take home as a one-of-a-kind souvenir. Surrounded by the charm of a modern apothecary with a boho-industrial twist, you’ll enjoy a fun, social, and interactive workshop perfect for couples, friends, and solo travelers looking for something unforgettable and uniquely Tampa.
